messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
您可以選擇以下幾種材料來訂製馬的雕塑：

| 材料 | 特色 |
|------|------|
| 青銅（Bronze） | 耐久、光澤感強，適合細節表現 |
| 大理石（Marble） | 高雅、質感柔和，適合傳統風格 |
| 陶土（Terracotta） | 低成本、可塑性好，適合粗獷風格 |
| 木材（Wood） | 自然紋理，溫暖感，易於加工 |
| 石材（Stone） | 堅固、重量感強，適合大型作品 |

如果您已經決定要訂製青銅馬雕塑，請告訴我您想要的尺寸（英吋），我可以為您下單。
message.reasoning: The user says: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" They want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "有哪些材料選擇？" They want to know what materials are available. According to the tool, we can order a custom sculpture with subject item and material. The materials options are Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. But the user specifically wants bronze. So we should respond with the available materials. We might also ask if they want to proceed with ordering. But the user only asked about materials. So we can answer: "您可以選擇青銅、大理石、陶土、木材或石材". Then maybe ask if they'd like to place an order. But we should not call the function unless they want to order. The user didn't request an order. So we just respond with the list.
